news.title: NDA Securities Limited announced that it expects to receive INR 640.5 million in funding from Titanium Holdings India Private Limited, Bir Foods & Restaurants Private Limited, Regenci Wealth Management & Advisory Private Limited, Blackburg Asset Management Private Limited and other investors.
news.body: NDA Securities Limited announced private placement to issue 17,500,000 Equity shares at an issue price of INR 36.60 per share for gross proceeds of INR 640,500,000 on February 18, 2026. The transaction includes participation from Ram Gopal Jindal  for 400,000 shares, Titanium Holdings India Private Limited for 5,500,000 shares, Bir Foods & Restaurants Private Limited for 5,500,000 shares, Regenci Wealth Management & Advisory Private Limited for 1,700,000 shares, Osgood Tie-Up Private Limited for 1,700,000 shares, Nevigating Merchants Private Limited for 1,000,000 shares, Blackburg Asset Management Private Limited for 1,700,000 shares. news.title: New minor risk - Profit margin trend
news.body: The company's profit margins are lower than last year and have reduced by more than 30%. Net profit margin: 2.5% Last year net profit margin: 11% This is considered a minor risk. A large drop in profit margin could indicate the company does not have strong competitive advantages or it is yet to establish itself and its core business. Even if it is a well established business, this may make it a much riskier investment than one that has a combination of proven competitive advantages and a stable or growing profit margin. Currently, the following risks have been identified for the company: Major Risks Share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months (13% average weekly change). news.title: NDA Securities Limited Announces Regularization of Appointment of Kajal Goel as Managing Director
news.body: NDA Securities Limited at its Extraordinary General Meeting held on January 8, 2026 announced Regularization of appointment of Ms. Kajal Goel (DIN: 10634514) as Managing Director of the Company.
